tweetText: Deloitte says businesses need to move beyond basic AI features and adopt "autonomous intelligence" for true growth. This shift could fundamentally change how companies operate and boost their bottom lines. via AI News

The Musk v. Altman trial has concluded, focusing on whether we can trust AI leaders. This matters as SpaceX approaches a massive IPO, highlighting the future of AI and entrepreneurship. via TechCrunch AI

Lake Tahoe, a popular getaway for Silicon Valley, is facing rising energy prices due to increased demand from AI. This situation highlights the growing impact of technology on local economies. via TechCrunch AI

OpenAI just launched ChatGPT for personal finance, letting you connect bank accounts to see your portfolio, spending, subscriptions, and upcoming bills in one place. It could make tracking your money way easier. via TechCrunch AI
Runway started helping filmmakers now wants to beat Google at AI video. They're betting video generation is the path to world models and being an outsider gives them an edge. via TechCrunch AI

Osaurus just launched a Mac app that combines local and cloud AI models, letting users keep control of their memory, files, and tools. This matters because it enhances privacy and customization for Mac users. via TechCrunch AI

Greg Brockman is now in charge of OpenAI's products as the company restructures to merge ChatGPT and Codex into a single experience. This move aims to streamline their offerings and enhance user experience. via WIRED AI

Mira Murati, founder of Thinking Machines Lab, emphasizes creating AI that collaborates with humans instead of replacing them. This approach highlights the importance of keeping people involved in the AI process. via WIRED AI.

YouTube is rolling out its AI deepfake detection tool to all adult users, allowing them to monitor for lookalikes on the platform. This move is important for user safety and privacy as deepfakes become more common. via The Verge AI

ArXiv is banning researchers for a year if they upload papers with unchecked AI-generated content. This move aims to maintain the integrity of academic research amid concerns over AI's accuracy. via The Verge AI
